definition.prompt: Photorealistic commercial poster of a glass strawberry jam jar floating in mid-air, glossy red jam, black lid, cream label facing camera reading exactly "BERRY DAY". A jam splash arcs around the jar with whole and sliced strawberries and green leaves; keep label unobscured. Behind it, a simple generic smartphone social-feed frame with neutral icon shapes, no third-party logos or extra words. Red-orange gradient backdrop, macro commercial lighting, portrait 4:5.

review.notes: Floating jam jar with legible BERRY DAY label, red splash, strawberries and leaves; a generic phone feed sits behind it on a red-orange background.
